title: Australian Baked Hake with Lemon and Herbs
description: A simple and flavorful Australian-inspired baked hake dish, topped with a mixture of lemon juice, olive oil, and herbs. Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad for a light and refreshing meal.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the hake fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the hake with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Drizzle the olive oil over the hake fillets.
Top each hake fillet with a mixture of lemon juice, parsley, and thyme.
Place the hake fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake the hake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the hake hot with lemon slices on top.
